_comment: Public Luma (luma.com, formerly lu.ma) sources for mapsee_ingest_luma.py. `calendars` are one organiser's calendar (/calendar/get-items); `places` are a whole city's Discover feed (/discover/get-paginated-events). Each entry needs EITHER an explicit calendar_api_id / discover_place_api_id, OR a `url` - any luma.com slug, including a single event page, which resolves to the calendar that owns it. Category is the mapsee frontend key and only a default; derive_categories in mapsee_supabase_sync promotes from the text. READ THE ADAPTER'S DOCSTRING BEFORE ADDING A CITY: Discover takes `discover_place_api_id`, and the plausible-looking `place_api_id` is accepted, ignored, and answered with events for whatever city the RUNNER's IP is in - Seattle asked for from AWS us-east-2 comes back as Columbus, Ohio, with a 200 and no error. `expect_region` makes that fail loudly instead of silently: the adapter checks the first event's region against it and refuses to ingest on a mismatch. Set it on every place.

calendars.name: ClawCon
calendars._comment: Reached from https://luma.com/clawcon-seattle, which is an EVENT page; the adapter resolves it to the ClawCon calendar (cal-e5mvjF86anukzOt) that owns it, so the whole series is tracked rather than the one listing.

calendars.name: A2ZERO Clothing Swaps (Ann Arbor)
calendars._comment: The City of Ann Arbor's Office of Sustainability and Innovations runs a monthly clothing swap (third Thursday, City Hall) and publishes it on Luma; a2gov.org's own page only links there. Found 2026-09-19 while searching for clothing swaps for the fleabop lens; the adapter resolved the URL to cal-RWiHgZTHATaedQu and kept 4 upcoming events, every one with coordinates in Ann Arbor.
